roleContext.roleTitle: Reliability Data Scientist, Theme Park Rides
roleContext.jobDescription: We operate three theme parks with 64 rides between them. The Reliability Data Scientist builds failure-prediction models from ride sensor and maintenance data, maintains the asset-health dashboard used by the engineering managers, runs failure-mode analyses with the maintenance planners and prepares the reliability statistics for the parks' annual review with the insurer. Because the analyses feed safety-critical maintenance intervals, the role requires a recognised reliability certification such as the SMRP CMRP or the ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer.

# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Reliability Data Scientist, Theme Park Rides

## Experience

- Data Scientist, Glenmoor Leisure Parks (June 2023 to September 2026): built survival models for wheel-assembly and brake-fin failures on two roller coasters from vibration readings and the work-order history, and flagged assets for inspection when the predicted risk passed the agreed limit.
- Maintained the asset-health dashboard in Power BI for the engineering managers of both parks, refreshed nightly from the maintenance management system.
- Facilitated failure-mode and effects analysis workshops with the maintenance planners for the water-ride pumps and recorded the agreed severity, occurrence and detection ratings.
- Calculated mean time between failures by ride and component for the 2025 review with the parks' insurer and wrote up the calculation method in an appendix.
- Graduate Analyst, Tarnley Rail Services (September 2021 to May 2023): cleaned axle-bearing temperature data and produced weekly fault summaries for the depot engineers.

## Work samples

- Work sample offered for the certification requirement: the capstone project from the online 'Reliability Analytics Professional Certificate' (six courses, issued by Lathe & Loom Learning in April 2026), a notebook predicting pump failures on a public dataset, with the programme's certificate of completion as its cover page.
